One-line description: AI call summaries and automatic CRM updates for Indian sales teams, including code-mixed languages.
What have you built?: A call-recording and transcription layer for sales teams, with summaries and CRM field updates. Handles Hindi-English, Tamil-English and Telugu- English calls.
Revenue: MRR INR 1.9 L (INR 500 per seat per month).
Unit economics: CAC about INR 48,000 per team, including founder time at a nominal salary. Gross margin 70%. Payback about 5 months.
Customer acquisition: Founder-led outbound brought 9 teams, referrals 5 and CRM consultants 2.
Competition: Gong and similar global tools, and meeting note-takers like Otter and Fireflies. We do not know of an India-first player.
Key risks: Telecom call-recording restrictions, accuracy on noisy calls, and customer concentration in BFSI.
Use of funds: Engineering and language models, sales, security and operations.
Anything else we should know?: We would value introductions to sales leaders at Indian BFSI and edtech companies.
Founder background: Arun Kumar (CEO): 6 years as a product lead at a CRM software company. Meenakshi S (CTO): 4 years in speech ML at a speech-technology company.
